mapper.select:
SELECT id, name, location, resource_type, unit_label, enabled FROM resource WHERE enabled = TRUE
AND resource_type = #{resourceType}
AND location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%')
ORDER BY resource_type, name, id
SELECT id, name, location, resource_type, unit_label, enabled FROM resource WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

where.if: AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR unit_label LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT id, name, location, resource_type, unit_label, enabled FROM resource
ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource (name, location, resource_type, unit_label, enabled) VALUES (#{name}, #{location}, #{resourceType}, #{unitLabel}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE resource SET name = #{name}, location = #{location}, resource_type = #{resourceType}, unit_label = #{unitLabel}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
